title: Identifier record
description: One dated record of an identifier: the namespace it belongs to, its number, and the rest of its key, so that a reference written with the number alone can be resolved, and a collision seen. The fields of the key are declared per namespace in register/namespaces.json. Records are appended, never edited. Kit v1.12. CC0 1.0.

id.description: Stable identifier of this record. Never reused.

namespace.description: A namespace declared in register/namespaces.json: blog, log, gsr, om, file.

number.description: The number as written: 206(E), F.1/1/2021-PPD, 30, or a file's name.

key.description: The rest of the key, as the namespace declares it (for gsr: date and amends; for blog: title; for file: name, url, sha256 and edition). A dash means not established.

sha256.description: 64 lower-case hex digits, or a dash

what.description: What the identifier names, in a few words.

source.description: Where the key's values were taken from.

supersedes.description: The id of a record in the same namespace that this one replaces. A record is replaced at most once; the chain may not return to itself.
